messages:
Rina: Okay team: tiny seasonal idea 1: "Virtual Cookie Jar" + anonymous "Recipe Confessions". Drop a one-line guilty-pleasure holiday recipe (real or invented) in the jar by Fri and well publish a silly zine. :cookie::notebook:

Omar: Do we mean actual baked goods or microwave-abomination recipes? Asking for a friend. :eyes:

Grace: Microwave-abomination here. My famous \"leftover-stuffing-toastie\" is a vibe.

Tomas: I will submit Grandma's secret ginger-molasses-latkes recipe. Totally real and very questionable.

Faye: Can we do anonymous submissions? I have a recipe that is only acceptable when served at 2AM with regrets. :laughing:

Rina: Anonymous is the point! Put submissions in the Google Form: https://intranet.redwood/cookiejar-2025 (one-liners only). Were aiming for short + silly.

cleo-bot: Reminder: Cookie Jar form closes Fri 5:00 PM; zine PDF will be posted next Mon.

Omar: Also throw in a tiny poll: most likely to be eaten in one sitting vs gifted to HR.

Grace: Vote idea: add emoji reactions to the final collage post to pick \"Most Apologetic Recipe\". Remote folks can react too.

Tomas: Logistics Q: if someone actually bakes and wants to share, is there a safe-drop plan? I can coordinate a pickup box and cooling rack.

Rina: Yes please label perishables with name + ingredients. If youre shipping, message me first. We prefer shelf-stable or tiny samples only. No nut surprises.

Faye: I will probably send my \"Cinnamon Toast Dog Treats\" (joke recipe). Maybe Ill actually bring cookies.

Omar: Idea: include one non-food tiny thing in the jar like a haiku or a holiday micro-tip. Adds variety.

Grace: Submitting: \"Leftover-stuffing-toastie 1 slice bread, stuffing, cheese, microwave 45s. Serve with dignity.

Tomas: Submitting: \"Grandma's questionable ginger-molasses-latkes: proceed with caution and extra lemon.

Faye: Submitting anonymously: \"Midnight snowflake cereal bowl: cereal + marshmallows + drizzle of maple syrup. Eat in bed, accept consequences.

Rina: Love these. If anyone wants to help make the zine look cute, Im taking volunteers to compile + add tiny doodles. Low-commitment.

cleo-bot: Zine volunteers: Rina, Grace. Add your name to the doc if you want to help: https://intranet.redwood/cookiejar-zine-edit

Omar: Can we have a micro-prize for top 3 submissions? Ill donate a tin of fancy hot cocoa packets.

Tomas: Vote: donate cocoa + a random novelty spoon. Good prize.

Faye: Also proposing a \"Most Likely to Be Reheated at 3AM\" honorary mention.

Rina: Done. Prize categories: \"Most Apologetic\", \"Most Likely to Be Reheated at 3AM\", \"Most Nostalgic\". Winners get cocoa + sticker.

Grace: Tiny ask: can someone scan entries for actual food allergens before publishing? I can do a pass for common allergens and add a note.

Rina: Thank you! Please flag anything with nuts, dairy, gluten. We'll add a blanket allergen disclaimer on the zine.

cleo-bot: Final reminder: Form closes Fri 5:00 PM. Zine release next Mon morning in #random.

Omar: Submitting one more: \"Office mystery bar: canned caramel + pretzel crumbs. Unknown origin. Consume responsibly.

Faye: This was fun. Thanks Rina for organizing. If the zine is good, can we print a few physical copies? I would like to wallpaper my desk with it. :grin:

Rina: Printing a small run is a yes if volunteers chip in. Otherwise PDF will be glorious and messy. Happy holidays and may your cookies not catch fire! :sparkles:
